usage: Persist this file inside your repositories as .codescene/custom-quality-gates.json Enable/disable quality gates for specific paths. Rules are tried in order and the first rule that matches will apply. If no rule is matched, all quality gates are disabled. If you want to use a default set of gates specify a rule with matching_content-path **/* as the last rule. You can delete _doc keys, they are not used.

rule_sets.quality_gates_doc: Specify a quality profile: clean_code_collective, bare_minimum, pay_down_tech_debt
rule_sets.matching_team_doc: Specify a team name, if a member of a team modifies a file, file matches the rule.
